name: context-meter
description: Live context-window meter: a band above the prompt, a breakdown pane, threshold alerts, a /ctx command, and a status line at the end of each reply where the surface draws no mod UI. By default it adds a short context-usage reading to each prompt (setting: replyStatusLine)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the status line, band, pane and alerts.

warnPercent.title: Yellow from (%)
warnPercent.description: The meter turns yellow at this fill percentage.

dangerPercent.title: Red and first alert from (%)
dangerPercent.description: The meter turns red and the first alert fires at this fill percentage.

criticalPercent.title: Second alert from (%)
criticalPercent.description: A second alert fires at this fill percentage.

replyStatusLine.title: Status line at the end of each reply
replyStatusLine.description: Adds the live reading to each prompt as hidden context so Claude ends its reply with one status line. Useful where mod UI is not drawn (a Cowork chat). Costs a few dozen tokens per turn.
